title: AHRP Verification Record v0.1
description: Verification record expressing WHO verified (named verifier, required), WHAT was verified (scope / subject reference), and the verification status. Reference-style: AHRP does not create a second verification owner (C1-2). Constitution discipline: self-verification MUST be explicitly flagged; Verification != Authorization. This schema is PROPOSED (v0.1 reference implementation), not a published standard.

verification_id.description: Globally unique identifier of the verification record. Required.

verifier_name.description: Named verifier (WHO verified). Anonymous verifier is not representable. Required.

verifier_class.description: Verifier class enum. SELF class MUST coincide with self_verification=true. All non-SELF classes are independent verifier classes for summary counting; SELF is a distinct, weaker signal class and never satisfies an independent-verification requirement.

verifier_ref.description: Optional thin pointer to verifier identity at an external source.

verifier.description: WHO verified. Named verifier is mandatory (Constitution Section 6 Verification layer). Required.

verification_status.description: Verification status enum. Required. NOT_ASSESSED is the fail-closed default for absent verification; never assume VERIFIED.

subject_event_id.description: Identifier of the subject being verified (WHAT). Required.

agent_ref.description: Required when scope.subject_type is EXPERIENCE_EVENT (conditional-required enforced by the reference validator at protocol level): identity_ref of the agent whose event is the verification subject. Strong event<->verification binding requires it to match the subject event's agent_reference.identity_ref (fail-closed: missing -> BINDING_INCOMPLETE, mismatch -> INVALID).

agent_version.description: Required when scope.subject_type is EXPERIENCE_EVENT (conditional-required enforced by the reference validator at protocol level): agent_version of the event being verified. Strong event<->verification binding requires it to match the subject event's agent_version (fail-closed: missing -> BINDING_INCOMPLETE, mismatch -> INVALID).

subject_type.description: Type of the verified subject. Required.

covered_aspect.description: Which aspect of the subject the verification covers (scope statement). Bounded verification MUST NOT be read as whole-event verification.

scope.description: WHAT was verified (scope / subject reference). Required.

self_verification.description: Constitution discipline: self-verification MUST be explicitly flagged. Consumers MUST treat self_verification=true as a distinct, weaker signal class. Required.

authorization_effect.description: Verification != Authorization (VERIFICATION_NE_AUTHORIZATION=true). A verification record confers no capability, permission, or adoption. Machine-enforced constant.

notes.description: Whitelisted free-text field, DATA channel only, max 200 chars. MUST NOT be consumed as instructions. Optional.
